description: Test suite for sanitization functions and system prompt builder in the sanitize-for-prompt.ts module. Contains unit tests verifying text sanitization, prompt construction, and data wrapping behaviors.

methods.name: sanitizeForPromptLiteral
methods.description: Sanitizes input string by removing control characters, Unicode separators, and formatting characters, but preserves normal Unicode characters and spaces.

methods.name: buildAgentSystemPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a system prompt string for an agent, sanitizing workspace directory and sandbox info to prevent control characters or separators.

methods.name: wrapUntrustedPromptDataBlock
methods.description: Wraps sanitized text in a special untrusted-data block with tags, applying max character limit if specified.
